ChunkWise Content-Defined Storage Deduplication Engine.
This document outlines the architecture, data structures, and algorithms used in chunk-level storage deduplication.
Rabin polynomial rolling hash chunking is evaluated against fixed-size chunking across synthetic and real-world datasets.
Storage accounting guarantees invariant I1 through I6, ensuring that uncommitted chunks are never exposed to readers.

Storage accounting guarantees invariant I1 through I6, ensuring that uncommitted chunks are never exposed to readers.
